Hello, Regina.
It's Ezra.
I wanted to give you an update about our client Wang Sporting Goods.
They want to meet with us to discuss the artwork for their upcoming advertising campaign.
They like what we've done so far, but they have some other ideas they want to share with us.
Representatives from Wang Sporting Goods will be in town on Wednesday.
I reserved Conference Room A, the one with the large screen, for a large screen, for a large screen. could you please bring your laptop computer to the meeting to show our work?

我是 Ezra。

Wang Sporting Goods 的代表周三会到城里来。
我预订了 A 会议室，就是带大屏幕的那个，用于展示我们的工作？
